remarks: This is a great rental in Mid City. The freshly painted unit is nice and clean with Granite Island overlooking living area. Windows let in lots of light,  The rent includes includes heat hot water and cooking gas. This secure building offers reserved parking, on site laundry, elevator and nice clean and well maintained premises. The building is located on the bus line and within walking distance to just about everything as well as short drive to train station, I-95 beaches and parks. ask about Move in
